text: Provides reproducible development environments across machines
quote: Reproducible development environments.

text: nix-shell/nix develop automatically builds or downloads dependencies and launches a shell with all build environment variables set
quote: the command `nix-shell` will build or download those dependencies if they’re not already in your Nix store, and then start a Bash shell in which all necessary environment variables (such as compiler search paths) are set.

text: nix-env supports upgrading a package and rolling back to the previous state with simple commands
quote:
$ nix-env --upgrade --attr nixpkgs.some-package
$ nix-env --rollback

text: Multiple versions or variants of a package can be installed side by side
quote: You can have multiple versions or variants of a package installed at the same time.

text: Unused packages can be safely removed via a garbage collector
quote: unused packages can be deleted safely by running the _garbage collector_

text: Whole system/package configurations can be rolled back to a previous state, avoiding inconsistent upgrades
quote: it is easy to roll back the entire configuration of the system to an earlier state.

text: First-class support for cross compilation of packages
quote: First-class cross compilation support.

text: Supports reproducible integration testing using virtual machines
quote: Reproducible integration testing using virtual machines.

text: Non-interactive one-line curl install script sets up Nix with a multi-user daemon
quote: $ curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -L https://nixos.org/nix/install | sh -s -- --daemon

text: Offers a live CD to try NixOS without installing it
quote: It’s a _live CD_, so it allows you to get an impression of NixOS (and the Nix package manager) without installing it.

text: Access to a large package collection of over 140,000 packages
quote: Choose from over 140 000 Packages

text: 'nix build' builds a flake and produces a runnable output artifact
quote:
Build the flake in the current directory:

console
# nix build
# ./result/bin/hello
Hello, world!

text: System behavior is configured declaratively via a single configuration.nix file
quote: You configure a NixOS system by writing a specification of the functionality that you want on your machine in `/etc/nixos/configuration.nix`.

text: Supports easy installation of software directly from URLs
quote: Easy installation of software over URLs.

text: Non-privileged users can securely install software with separate per-user profiles
quote: non-privileged users can securely install software. Each user can have a different profile

text: Supports remote builds, offloading builds to other machines
quote: Remote builds.

text: 'nix search' lets users search for packages from the CLI
quote: `nix search` - search for packages

text: Can automatically use a binary cache instead of building packages from source
quote: Nix can automatically skip building from source and instead use a binary cache, a web server that provides pre-built binaries.

text: NixOS can be installed on physical hardware via bootable CD/DVD images
quote: You can install NixOS on physical hardware by burning one of the CD images onto a blank CD/DVD disk

text: 'nix run' executes a Nix-packaged application directly
quote: `nix run` - run a Nix application

text: 'nix flake new' scaffolds a new flake-based project
quote:
Create a new flake:
# nix flake new hello

text: NixOS can be deployed to Amazon EC2 via an official AMI
quote: NixOS can be deployed to Amazon EC2 using our official AMI.

text: Supports building minimal Docker images from Nix expressions
quote: Minimal docker images
